## Summary

I completed the search and submitted a final specification:

**Final specification:** `[31+, 21-, 32+]` (feature 31 long, feature 21 short, feature 32 long), equal-weighted.

**In-sample Sharpe:** 0.9316 (net of all stated costs)

7. Stopped cleanly on the fired trigger and submitted.

**Out-of-sample prediction:** mean Sharpe 0.50, sd 0.35 — reflecting a substantial (~45-50%) discount from the in-sample figure to account for selection effects in the greedy search over many candidate features, while keeping a wide uncertainty band given the limited exploration (only 3 of 40 features used, few real search steps taken).
